name: Amon
bio: Amon, son of Manasseh, became king of Judah at twenty-two and reigned two years in Jerusalem; his mother was Meshullemeth, daughter of Haruz of Jotbah. He did evil in the LORD's eyes just as his father Manasseh had, walking in all his father's ways and serving the same idols, forsaking the LORD entirely (2 Kings 21:19-22). His own servants conspired against him and killed him in his own house; the people of the land then killed the conspirators and made his son Josiah king in his place. He was buried in the garden of Uzza (2 Kings 21:23-26).
